summary: A county’s concern about losing a familiar name delays a channel decision while staff clarify its advice.
realLife: O’Donnell asked what the county meant about losing Cutler, and the committee deferred the Florida channel proposal in December.
inGame: needs: the county letter, the request for clarification and any subsequent county reply.

turns.writesBack: Staff must obtain clarification before returning the case..

turns.pulledBy: The county explains which name it wants retained.
turns.writesBack: The chair can put the matter back on the docket..
